tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (kha)༄༅/ /ras ris la brten pa'i dkyil chog bzhugs/ /༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /nag po cho ga la brten nas/ /bsdus la dga'
(kha)༄༅/ /ras ris la brten pa'i dkyil chog bzhugs/ /༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /nag po cho ga la brten nas/ /bsdus la dga'

tei:div.tei:p: (kha)༄༅// ras ris la brten pa'i dkyil chog bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// nag po cho ga la brten nas// bsdus la dga' ba'i don gyi phyir// dbang bzhi'i cho ga mdor bsdus pa// dam pa'i gsung la brten te bri// dang por dad pa la sogs pa dang ldan pa'i slob mas/ bla ma la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas/ khyod zhabs pad+mo spangs nas ni// gtso bo gzhan la skyabs ma mchis// 'gro ba'i dpa' bo thub chen gyis// blo mchog bdag la gnang bar mdzod// ces lan gsum du'o// de nas bla mas/ yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas so sor thar pa'i 'dul ba la sngar bsnyen zhing da bsnyen pa la spro'am/ zhes dri/ sngar bsnyen na mi dgos/ ma bsnyen na phyi'i sems bskyed bya/ bla ma lnga bcu pa nas bshad pa ltar/ gnyis ka'i rgyud brtag so sor mgu na gsol ba gdab pa ni/ yon tan thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid can// ston pa'i bstan pa legs gnas pa'i// bde mchog cho ga bshad du gsol// zhes lan gsum du'o// de nas bla mas yo byad 'byor ram dri ba ni/ 'khor lo mchod pa'i yo byad rnams// khyod kyis thams cad 'byor gyur tam// rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma dga' bar// gus pa yis ni byed nus sam// zhes gcig gam gsum du dri/ lan yang de nyid kyi mthar/ gus pa yis ni byed nus so// zhes gdab bo// de nas dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung nus sam dri ba ni/ he ru ka dpal tshul 'di la// bza' dang sku la brten pa dang*// skye ba mang po'i sdig pa ni// bsags pa rnam par 'jig byed pa// dpa' khyod 'khor lo sdom pa yi// sdom pa so sor bsrung nus sam// zhes gcig gam gsum du dri/ lan yang de nyid kyi mthar/ sdom pa so sor bsrung nus so// zhes gdab bo// de nas tshogs 'khor bya/ bsnyen pa'i yo byad dbul/ bla mas bsnyen pa rab 'bring gsum/

las dang po pas grangs kyi bsnyen pa gtso bor bya'o// da ni bsnyen pa sngon du song ba la rten sa chog 'byung ba yin pa las/ 'dir bris sku la brten pa'i phyogs yin pas sa'i cho ga ni ma bkod do// de yang rdo rje dril bu pas dkyil 'khor gsum gang yang rung ba la brten nas dbang bskur du rung bar gsungs te/ ri mor gnas pa'i las dang ni// thig la tshon dgye'i rim pas bstan// 'gro ba thams cad rang bzhin gyis// grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis med pa'o// bcos ma gnyis kyi ngo bo gang*// de ni gdul bya'i dbang las 'dod// mkhas pas bsgrub bya de min te// yang dag don mthong grol phyir ro// zhes 'byung ngo*// de nas spyi don gsum pa sta gon ni/ sa phyogs ba byung dang bdud rtsi rnam pa lngas byug de yang khru do la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa bya'o// mchod pa ci 'byor pa bsham/ de nas rang gi mngon rtogs rdzogs par bsgom/ sangs rgyas la mchod/ dam tshig can la gtor ma gnyis dbul/ bar 'dir tshogs la longs spyad la 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma dbul/ 'das pa'i bzhag dkyil 'khor bsdus la rang nyid yab yum gyi nga rgyal du gnas pas/ sa'i lha mo sta gon du gnas pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal la dri'i thig le dang*/ me tog gi tshom bu bya/ srin lag g.yon pa'i rtsa bar haṃ yig bsams la/ srin lag sa la brdab cing*/ haṃ zhes brjod pas me tog gi steng du sa'i lha mo gser mdog tu snang ba phyag gnyis kyis rin po che'i bum pa bsnams pa blos dmigs la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon/ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ gis zhabs bsil/ de bzhin du me tog la sogs pa yang so so'i sngags kyis phul la/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyis// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// shākya seng ge skyob pa yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de ltar bdag gis bdud sde las// rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri// zhes lan gsum du brjod pas sta gon du gnas pa bya'o// de nas me tog bsal te/

sa phyogs dang skyang nul bya/ de nas lha lhag par gnas par bya ba'i phyir dri'i thig le dang*/ me tog gi tshom bu sum cu rtsa bdun/ thod pa bzhi dang zhe gcig dur khrod brgyad dang zhe dgu bkod la/ tshom bu dbus ma'i steng du ā li las zla ba/ kā li las nyi ma/ bar du hūm̐ las rdo rje/ de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las/ lha sum cu so bdun rten dang brten par bcas pa dus gcig la bskyed/ yab yum gyi go cha bkod/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug bya/ dbang bskur zhing rgyas gdab/ sngags mchod nas bzung nas phyi mchod dang*/ ras zung dang*/ ku sha dang*/ yid las byung ba dang*/ nang mchod dang*/ rab tu mnyes pa'i dang*/ blos sprul pa la sogs pas ci nus nus su mchod cing bstod la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ gnyis med ye shes las byung ba'i// khyab bdag kun dngos bdag nyid can// ston pa'i gtso bo khrag 'thung dpal// phag mo lhan cig yang dag sbyor// gang zhig phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang*// rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can// byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// slob ma rnams la phan pa dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// rdo rje can bdag 'di zhes pa// nang par dkyil 'khor bri bar bgyid// rjes su brtse bar nyer dgongs te// kun gyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes lan gsum du bdud rtsi lnga dang sha'i bdug spos thogs la bya'o// bar 'dir 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma btang yang btub/ de nas slob ma lhag par gnas par bya ba'i phyir khrus byas maṇ+ḍal 'bul du bcug la/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa bskyed du gzhug pa'i phyir/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni gzhug par bya// bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan// bdag gzhan 'jig rten pha rol gnyer// dad pa chen po ldan pa gang*// 'jig rten pha rol la dmigs nas// blo ldan dkyil 'khor gzhug bya ste// tshe 'di'i 'bras bu gnyer mi bya// gal te 'di 'bras don gnyer na// 'jig rten pha rol 'grub mi 'gyur// 'jig rten pha rol la dmigs na// 'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub// ces brjod la bshad pa bya/

de nas slob ma yid kyis kha nas bcug la/ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ yum gyi dku g.yon pa nas bton la dkyil 'khor gyi sgor yid kyis bzhag ste/ gsol ba 'debs su gzhug pa ni/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa po// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul ston pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab la/ spro ba bskyed pa ni/ bu tshur theg pa chen po la// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin gyis// gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga 'di// khyod la yang dag bshad par bya// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*// de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang*// da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// 'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa gang*// de dag kun kyang gsang sngags kyi// cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas// dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes// gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med des// skyob pa dpal ldan he ru kas// bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i// dpung chen dag kyang des bcom nas// 'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yi blo gros 'di gyis shig /de nas nang gi sems bskyed pa ni maṇ+ḍal tshom bu lnga pa la brten nas/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi// rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma// 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can// kun la bdag ni skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo// byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che// khyad par du yang slob dpon la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs dpa' bo// rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs// byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung nas// ji srid gnyis med la gnas par// de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med pa// nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bsrung*// de nas byang chub kyi sems bsrung ba'i phyir// slob dpon gyi srin lag g.yon pa'i khrag dang*/

bdud rtsi lnga bsres la/ dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga rnams su reg cing 'bru gsum brjod/ gnas gsum po der phyag rgya gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa bsgom/ slob ma lhag pa'i lhar bsam la mchod pa lngas mchod/ srung skud dmar po la mdud pa gsum byas la hūm̐ las dam tshig gi skud par bskyed cing*/ ye shes kyi skud pa bstim/ yi ge bdun pa bzlas shing dpung pa g.yon par bcings la yi ge brgya pas brtan par bya/ de nas bdud rtsi sbyar ba khar blud cing*/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥsarba pā paṃ ni tsa s+ya saṃ shodha ya sarba bi kalpa a pa na ye swā hā/ zhes bzlas la/ lus la yang gtor/ de nas so shing gas chag med pa sor bcu gnyis pa rtse mo la me tog btags pa lag pa g.yon pas bzung*/ gser dngul las byas par mos la so brud pas sdig pa skyugs par bsam ltos pa med par dor/ dngos grub bam phrin las gang 'grub brtag rang la bltas na mchog steng du bltas na mkha' spyod la sogs pa grub pa brgyad/ 'og tu bltas na sa 'og phyogs mtshams su bltas na las phran tshegs 'grub bo// de nas dhiḥbazlas pa'i ku sha stan dang*/ ha bzlas pa sngas su byin la/ chos zab mo bshad de spro ba bskyed pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum+ba ra'i me tog bzhin// brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gis sems can mnyam med don// mya ngan mi 'da' byed par 'gyur// bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// sngon du sdig pa byas pa yang*// dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /thams cad zad par 'gyur yin na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i// tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos// skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni// go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur// gang gis spyod pa'i mchog 'di la/ blo gros shin tu mi g.yo bas// sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi// ngan 'gro de yis gcod par 'gyur// bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis// rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed// gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa'i// bdag nyid chen po thams cad kyi// bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun// yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin par// de phyir khyed rnams theg chen du// legs pa nyid du 'gro bar 'gyur// theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i// lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan// khyed rnams der ni dong bas na// rang byung bskal pa chen po pa// 'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi// de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur// zhes spro ba bskyed la glo g.yas pa sa la phab ste/

dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa de nyid du nyal ba'am/ gzhan du yang rung ste nyal la rmi lam brtag ngan na bsrung ngo*// de la ngan pa ni chus khyer ba la sogs pa'o// bzang ba ni ri phug tu nyi ma 'de ba la sogs pa'o// slob ma lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga'o// de nas bum pa lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga ni/ mdor bsdu na gnyis su bcas pa lhag par bkru/ skya zhal byug rnam rgyal la shog bu la rigs lnga'i mtshan ma bris la gdags/ las thams cad pa la sna tshogs rdo rje bri/ mgul chings bcing*/ gu gul gyis bdug cing sum+bha ni bzlas/ yungs kar brdeg gnyis ka'i nang du sman lnga dang 'bru lnga dang*/ rin po che lnga gzhug bdud rtsi lnga blugs/ dri zhim po'i chus dgang*/ kha rgyan me tog gi phreng ba gdags/ rnam rgyal du dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bskyed/ go cha dgod/ ye shes pa gzhug dbang bskur zhing rgyas gdab/ phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod/ las thams cad par bde ba chen po'i lha lnga'am/ khaṇ+ḍa ro hā gang rung bskyed/ de la ye shes pa gzhug pa la sogs pa thams cad rdzogs par bya'o// de nas rnam rgyal du lha rdzogs pa'i sngags sam yum gyi nye snying sarba bud+dha la sogs pa brgya rtsa'am nyer gcig bzlas so// las thams cad par yang de nyid dam/ khaṇ+ḍa ro hā bzlas/ yang na bde chen gyi lha lnga'i sngags bzlas kyang rung ngo*// de nas bum pa'i steng gi thod pa'i bdud rtsi de bum pa gnyis su bgos la blugs pas lha thams cad 'od du zhu bar bsam mo// bum pa sta gon no// de nas dkyil 'khor zhag gi nub mo gnas khang phyag dar byas la/ ba byung dang bdud rtsi bsres pas byug bris sku zhal dbye/ bris sku'i phyogs mtshams brgyad du me tog dang spos la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad ci 'byor pa bsham/ nang mchod dang*/ med du mi rung ba ras zung dang*/ ku sha dang*/ gtor ma gnyis la sogs pa'ang bsham mo// de nas bdag nyid lha'i rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgoms la bdag nyid la mchod pa ci 'grub bya/

de nas rang gi dkyil 'khor sna bug g.yas g.yon gnyis nas phyed phyed du byas te snying gar bsdu/ de nas bris sku'i bgegs sbyang ba'i phyir gtor ma gsum la/ sarba bi gh+nan sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bhi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ uṅga te s+pha ra na i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇa dāṃ/ ba liṃ te swā hā/ zhes pa lan gsum du brjod de bskor zhing gtang*/ ting lo chang bu gsum la yang*/ sum+bha ni brjod cing bskor la gtang*/ gu gul gyis bdug nyungs kar gyis brab/ drag pos sbyang ba'o// g.yas su me g.yon du chu bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na ya swā hā/ zhes brjod de lag pa g.yas pas til mer bsreg g.yon pas til chur dor/ de nas me yang chur blugs la bzhi mdor dor ro// slob dpon dang slob ma gnyis ka'i sdig pa sbyang ba'o// de nas bris sku la me long bstan la de'i gzugs brnyan shar ba la/ ji ltar bltams pa la sogs pa'i tshigs bcad brjod cing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes bya ba la sogs pas mi gtsang ba'i dri ma bkru'o// de nas bris sku de sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar/ dam tshig sems dpa' bskyed pa la sogs pa yan lag bzhis lhar rdzogs par bskyed la/ lha rnams rdzogs pa'i sngags dang*/ yum gyi nye snying dang*/ sgo ma bzhi'i phreng sngags dang*/ ā li kā li dang*/ yi ge brgya pas byin gyis brlabs pas brtan par bya/ de nas dngos su 'byor pa'am yid las byung ba'i mchod pa'i rnam pa thams cad dang*/ nang bdud rtsi dang*/ 'khyud ba'i dang*/ bla na med pa'i dang bstod pa'i bar ni sangs rgyas la mchod pa'o// de nas dur khrod kyi bdag po rnams la gtor ma rgya chen po gtang*/ dam tshig can gyi skye bo tshogs pa rnams la bza' btung gi longs spyod kyis tshim par byas te/ slob dpon bdag nyid kyis dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa nas brtsams te/

slob ma la ji tsam bskur gyi dbang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo las blang ngo*// de tsam gyis ni dkyil 'khor chen po mchod pa dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug pa'i cho ga bstan to// de nas slob ma dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa ni/ slob dpon gyis las thams cad pa'i bum pa dang*/ gdong g.yogs dang rdo rje khyer la lha'i nga rgyal brtan par byas te/ bden pa'i stobs brjod pa ni/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// de nyid de bzhin nges par 'byung*// bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor du// gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams// kun gyis sgrib med mthong bar shog /ces lan gsum brjod do// de nas slob ma rnam snang du dmigs la a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ zhes brjod la gdong g.yogs dmar po bcing*/ lag tu me tog gi phreng ba gtad/ las thams cad pa'i chus spyi bo nas bran zhing sum bha ni bzlas so// de nas 'jug pa'i dri ba ni/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'// zhes bzlas so// slob mas/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la dga' 'o// zhes lan btab/ de nas phyi'i 'jug pa'i phyir/ snying gar rdo rje bzung la/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa da ya mi/ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ hoḥsid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod do// de nas slob dpon gyis 'di skad brjod par bya ste/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis rlob par 'gyur gyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no// zhes brjod do// de nas hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐ zhes brjod la slob ma'i lag pa nas rdo rjes drangs nas yol ba'i nang du gzhug go /de tsam gyis ni phyi'i 'jug pa'o// de nas/

gong nas gong gi sdom pa ni// bu khyod kyis ni bzung byas te// grol ba'i rgyu ni de las gzhan// thabs ni cung zad yod ma yin// zhes dam tshig bsgrag go /de nas nye snying brjod cing*/ bdud rtsi khar blugs so// de nas yang lhag pa'i lhar mos la/ slob ma la go cha bskon/ slob ma'i lag pa g.yas pa nas bzung la/ oṃ shrī he ru kā ya bid/ ma hā bi d+ya rā dzā yā dhi ma he swā hā/ zhes rang gi sems nyid la dpa' bos bskul/ de nas/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// ces pas bla ma la phyag 'tshal/ yang*/ dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo// rnal 'byor gnas la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes zhe thag pas lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su 'gro bar bya'o// de nas slob mas slob dpon la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ don dam smra ba'i seng ge rnal 'byor zhes bya ba// nyon mongs gcod pa'i don la shin tu mkhas gyur pa// srid pa'i nyes brgya bskyed rtsa nyon mongs chom mdzod la// rnal 'byor rgyal po don dam de nyid bdag la grub par mdzod// ces lan gsum du gsol ba gdab/ de nas slob dpon gyis lha la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba gdab bo// de nas grub na sngar dkyil 'khor la byas pa bzhin/ slob ma la bgegs dang*/ sdig pa dang*/ dri ma sbyang ba gsum kar bya'o// ma grub na bgegs sbyang ba tsam la brten nas/ slob ma skad cig tsam gyis stong par bsgom la/ mngon par byang chub pa lnga'am/ skad cig gis slob ma he ru ka zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis par bskyed la/ de'i snying gar yang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bskyed la/ ye shes sems dpa' rnams lha'i rnam pa'am/

ā li kā li'i rnam par bkug ste/ slob ma'i snying gar bstim/ slob ma'i lus thams cad lha'am yig 'brus khyab par bsam/ de tsam gyis lha dang skal ba mnyam par byas shing*/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i ngo bo yin no// de nas byin gyis brlab pa'i phyag ni/ oṃ na maste hūm̐/ na mā mi hūm̐/ na mo na ma hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes bya bas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas 'jug pa'i sgo lho phyogs nas phyag gsum bya'o// spros pa la dga' bas ni/ g.yon skor gyis phyogs thams cad nas phyag bya'o// de'i sngags rgyas pa ni 'dir ma bkod do// de nas sdom pa dbog pa ni/ 'di'i lugs kyi sdom pa bsgrags pa tsam gyis kyang dbog par bzhed pas so// dang por sdom pa bsgrag pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*// 'di ni sangs rgyas rigs yid 'ong*// sdom pa brtan par gyur pa'o// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya ni// blo chen khyod kyis gzung bya ste// byang chub sems gang de rdo rje// shes rab dril bu zhes bsgrags so// slob dpon khyod kyis gzung bya ste// bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig sdom par gsungs pa'o// rin chen rigs la rtag tu ni// nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung*// 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba'o// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar gyis// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus gyis// zhes bsgrags so// slob dpon gyis bsgrags pa'i rjes su/ slob mas kyang bzlas pa bya ba ni/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming rdo rje 'di zhes pa// dus 'di nyid nas bzung nas ni// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis so sor brtan por bzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i// sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung*// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos kyang ma lus gzung*// las chen rigs ni bsdus pa la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bsrung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod// ces lan gsum brjod do// de nas ye shes dbab pa'i dam tshig bsgrag pa ni/

deng khyod dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ ngas khyod la dpal he ru ka'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes brjod do// yang snying gar rdo rje bzhag ste brjod pa/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// de nas bdud rtsi blud la brjod pa ni/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// oṃ pañca a mri ta u da ka ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥhūm̐/ de nas bla ma'i bka' mnyan par gdams pa ni/ deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyi he ru ka nga yin gyis/ ngas gang 'di gyis shig ces bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya'o// khyod kyis nga la brnyas par yang mi bya ste/ khyod yid mi bde ba ma spangs par tshe'i dus byas nas sems can dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes brjod do// de nas nang gi 'jug pa ye shes dbab par gsol ba gdab pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi byin gyis rlobs shig bdag la dpal he ru ka dbab tu gsol/ zhes smrar gzhug go /de nas rdzas dang sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyis bskul la dbab ste/ de'ang gzhung las 'byung ba'i rdzas kyis bdug cing*/ sku'i sbyor ba thams cad kyi rol mo'i sgra bya'o// ngag tu yab yum gyi snying po'i rjes la/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha ma hā kro dha ā be sha ya hūm̐/ om̐ shrī he ru kā ya bid ma he bid+ya rā dzā dhi ma he swā hā/

zhes brjod de/ de nas ting nge 'dzin gyis dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dpag tu med pa rnams/ de'i ba spu'i bu ga nas 'jug par bsam zhing snying gar thim par bsam mo// de nas lus la 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor yang bkod de/ rkang mthil du yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor g.yo ba ba dan dang bcas pa bsam/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du yi ge dzhaiṃ ljang gu bsam/ snying gar sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi rdo rjes mtshan pa/ mgrin par bam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ spyi bor yam̐ las rlung bsam mo// de nas rkang mthil gyi rlung dang mes nam mkha' la bteg spyi bo'i rlung gis mar phul bar bsam mo// de ltar slob dpon dang slob ma gnyis kas bsgoms na myur du 'bab par 'gyur ro// de nas sku gsung thugs gang babs kyang spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes pas brtan par bya'o// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i kha dog brtags la ltos pa med par me tog phreng ba dor/ slar yang blangs te oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa sa mi maṃ/ sa twa ma hā bā la/ zhes brjod la mgo la bcing*/ de nas/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni rtsom par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong bar 'gyur// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// ces brjod la gdong g.yogs dgrol/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha ngo bstan pa ni/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu skyed// khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes// sngags dang phyag rgya'i byin gyis brlabs// 'gro ba'i phun sum tshogs don dang*// dngos grub kun ni mngon du gyur// dam tshig thams cad bsrung ba dang*// gsang sngags la yang brtson par gyis// zhes brjod la lha gang la me tog phog pa gtso bor bstan cing*/ gzhan sgo srung nas gtso bo'i bar du bstan to// de yang*/ sna tshogs pad+mo'i lte bar bzhugs// gnyis med gnyis med pang na gnas// brtan g.yo kun gyi bdag nyid can// spyod dang grol bar rab brtson pa// kun mkhyen kun mdzad gtso bo ste// dpa' bo che la bu khyod ltos// zhes kyang brjod do// de dag tsam gyis ni slob ma dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga'o// de nas slob ma dbang bskur bar bya ba'i phyir/

ci 'byor pa'i yon bla ma rdo rje slob dpon la phul la/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba// ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas gtso// de bzhin bdag la deng stsol zhig /ces lan gsum du'o// rdo rje slob dpon du 'os pas de'i steng du yang*/ dpa' bo chen po mi ldog pa'i// dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon 'gyur// zhes lan gsum du'o// de nas sna tshogs pad+ma'am seng ge'i khri'i steng du slob ma bzhag la/ lha'i rnal 'byor 'dzin du gzhug sbyong ba rnam pa gsum 'jug pa'i skabs bzhin du bya'o// de nas dbang bskur ba bcu bzhi las/ thog mar me tog phreng ba'i dbang bskur ba ni/ sngar gyi me tog gang yin pa de lha la dbul te drin lan lan gyis blan pa'i tshul lo// slar yang blangs la mgo la btags te/ de'i rigs dang rjes su 'brel ba'i ming gdags so// de nas lha de nyid kyi snying po'am/ gtso bo'i snying po yi ge nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'i rjes su bzlas pa lan gsum gyis/ lha thams cad kyi bzlas pa'i lung thob par 'gyur ro// de nas rig pa'i dbang lnga la thog mar chu'i dbang ni/ bum pa'i nang du mi bskyod pa skad cig ma'am cho ga gsum gyis bskyed la/ de 'od du zhu ba'i chur bsam/ slob ma yang skad cig gis mi bskyod par bsgom du gzhug de nas bum pa thogs la nam mkha' la skad cig gis sgo mtshams ma brgyad byon par bsam ste/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bar bsam zhing*/ dngos su'ang bum pa'i chu blugs te/ sgo mtshams ma'i sngags kyi mthar badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca brjod do// de ni phyi'i dbang ngo*// de nas slob dpon gyi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis mi bskyod pa dpag tu med pa bkug ste/ slob ma'i spyi bor zla ba la aṃ bsam pa'i bu ga nas zhugs te/ lus thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rdul phra rab kyis khyab par bsam mo// de nas mchod pa lngas mchod/

phung po lnga las rnam shes dag nyon mongs pa zhe sdang dag chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes dang*/ mi bskyod pa'i dngos grub thob pa yin no// zhes bstan to// gnyis pa dbu rgyan gyi dbang ni dbu rgyan skad cig ma'am cho ga gsum gyi rin 'byung du bskyed/ slob ma'ang rin 'byung du bsgom du gzhug de nas phag mo'i snying po'i rjes la/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha mahā mu ku ṭa ho/ zhes brjod de dbu rgyan mgo la bzhag bum pa'i chus kyang sngar bzhin du ldugs pa ni phyi'i dbang ngo*// yang snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis rin chen byung ldan dpag tu med pa spyan drangs la/ slob ma'i spyi bo'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i bu ga na mar bstim la/ lus thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rdul phra rab tu bsam/ mchod pa lngas mchod/ tshor ba dang ser sna dag mnyam pa nyid dang*/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi skal ba dang mnyam par bstan to// gsum pa rdo rje'i dbang ni cho ga gsum mam skad cig mas/ rdo rje snang ba mtha' yas su bskyed/ slob ma'ang snang mthar bsgom du gzhug de nas/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// he ru ka dpal dbang bskur bas// de ring khyod la dbang bskur te// rab tu grub phyir rdo rje long*// zhes brjod la lag tu sbyin/ yang bum chus bran/ yang snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis snang ba mtha' yas dpag tu med pa spyan drangs la mgrin par pad+ma'i lte ba nas zhugs pas/ slob ma'i lus thams cad 'od dpag med kyi rdul phra rab kyis khengs par bsam pa ni nang gi dbang ngo*// yang mchod pa lngas mchod/ 'du shes dang 'dod chags gnyis dag so sor rtog pa dang snang ba mtha' yas kyi skal ba bzhag go zhes dran par bya'o// bzhi pa dril bu ni/ skad cig ma'am cho ga gsum gyis don yod grub par bskyed/ slob ma'ang don grub kyi nga rgyal bskyed du bcug la/ de nas/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag

/ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa// srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur// zhes brjod de lag pa g.yon par sbyin/ yang bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur ba ni phyi'i dbang ngo*// yang snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis don yod grub pa'i rdul phra rab kyis gang bar bsam pa ni nang gi dbang ngo*// lnga pa ming gi dbang ni dbang rdzas dngos su med pas rnam snang du bskyed pa med la/ slob ma rnam snang du bsgom du bcug ste/ de nas slob dpon gyis rdo rje dril bu bzung ste/ mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa bzhi'i mthar/ oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñca mi/ shrī he ru ka nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ zhes brjod la gang la me tog phog pa'i lha las dras pa'i ming gdags ting nge 'dzin gyis nam mkha' las mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa bzhis ming 'dogs par bsam/ yang bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas gtor ba phyi'i dbang ngo*// yang sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis rnam snang dpag tu med pa spyan drangs la/ slob ma'i spyi bo nas oṃ mgo thur ltas kyi bu ga na mar bstim pas/ lus thams cad rnam snang gi rdul phra rab kyis gang bar bsams la/ mchod pa ni nang gi dbang ngo*// spang bya gzugs dang*/ gti mug gnyis dag gnyen po me long lta bu dang*/ rnam snang gi skal ba dang ldan par byas pa'o zhes brjod pa'o// de ltar na me tog phreng ba dang rig pa'i dbang lnga dang drug go /de nas rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje dang mi 'bral bar bya ba'i phyir/ thun mong gi brtul zhugs ni/ yang slob ma mi bskyod par bsgom du gzhug slob dpon gyis de'i snying gar yang mi bskyod pa gcig bsgom pa ni nang gi dbang ngo*// de nas/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de// he ru ka dpal phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// he ru ka dpal brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi/

badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ/ dhā ra ya mi hūm̐ ha ha ha ho zhes brjod la lag tu rdo rje sbyin pa ni rdo rje'i brtul zhugs so// de nas spyod pa la nus mthu dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir/ thun mong ma yin pa'i brtul zhugs ni/ slob ma phyag bcu gnyis pa'i nga rgyal 'dzin du bcug la/ snying gar yang de 'dra gcig bsams la/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga lag tu byin la 'di skad du brjod de/ kha ṭ+wāṃ cang te'u lhung bzed bzang*// he ru ka dpal kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍā ma ru// rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rdo rje bcas// dril bu sil sil sgra sgrogs shing*// tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor bdag /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang rnal 'byor snod// dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis// zhes brjod do// de nas lha mchod pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas// sras dang bcas la rnam rol phyir// shes rab thabs kyis snyems bcas pas// gar mchod bde ba'i dga' ston gyis// a/ sgeg mo yi'o// sgeg dang bcas pas phreng ba 'phang*// sangs rgyas kun rdzogs rnal 'byor dang*// de yis 'bral bar mi 'gyur ro// phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no// oṃ/ phreng ba ma yi'o// lus can kun la dam chos kyi// glu ni khyod kyis blang bar bya// de nas rnal 'byor ma de dang*// myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur// gī/ glu ma yi'o// de nyid thal mo'i gar gyis ni// sangs rgyas thams cad chags par bya// sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i phrin las kyi// gar mkhan tshul du bsgyur bar gyis// hoḥ gar ma yi'o// sangs rgyas rnams la me tog gtor// byang chub yan lag tshogs gyur pas// mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi// bde gshegs sku ni thob par gyis// bh+rūm̐/ me tog ma yi'o// rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas// brtul zhugs bzang pos legs tshim gyis// lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su// ye shes kyis ni tshim par gyis// aḥ

bdug pa ma yi'o// chos kyi mar me legs sbar bas// pad+ma gar dbang rang nyid de// sems can ma rig ldongs pa la// ye shes sgron me 'bar bar gyis// pra/ mar me ma yi'o// khyod kyis rgyal la dri phul bas// tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang*// rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yis// byang chub lus can rnams la bsgos// gha/ dri chab ma yi'o// de nas sems can thams cad kyi don bya ba'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// 'jig rten ling thog bsal ba ltar// bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i// rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal// oṃ badz+ra ne tra ya a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ thur ma yi'o// chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// ngo bo med cing gnas med pa// chos rnams de ltar shes gyis la// sems can don ni bla med byos// 'on kyang rnal 'byor ma sras bskyed// me long gi'o// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// bya ba spyod tshul gsang ba yi// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis// 'khor lo yi'o// khyod kyi the tshom dogs med par// yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su// chos kyi dung ni bla med pa// dri med kun tu gang bar gyis// dung gi'o// de dag gis ni chos kyi de kho na nyid do// de nas bsgrub pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ zhi rgyas dbang dang dgug pa dang*// sdang bar bya dang gnod sogs dang*// gsod dang skrod pa thams cad de// las de rnams ni bsgrub par gyis// ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang*// mchil l+h+wam de bzhin ril bu ste// rnal 'byor ma yi dngos grub ni// de ni ci dga' thob par gyis// gnang ba'o// de nas dam tshig la bka'i gnang ba ni/ nang par sngar langs sems dag nyid// ma lus las ni byas nas su// bsrung dang bza' ba la sogs pa'i// sdom pa bdag nyid can bsrung ngo*// lus srog ltos pa med par yang*// dam tshig dang ni sdom pa bsrung*// nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du// nyin re bzhin ni bzla bar bya// gang tshe nyams na rnal 'byor pa// kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur// dgun zla 'bring po nas brtsams te// zla ba re res bsrung ba ni// gnyis med gnyis med 'khor lo gnas// tshes bcu la ni de rab mchod// sha dang chang sogs gang ci'ang rung*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs// thams cad gnyis med pang na gnas// he ru ka dpal rab tu mchod// theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya// sems can la yang rgyab mi phyogs// 'khor ba dag kyang mi spang zhing*// mya ngan 'das la dgar mi 'gro// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun la// khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya ste// phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang*// mtshan ma 'gom par mi bya'o// dam tshig rab bsrungs bsod nams kyis// tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur// bud med thams cad mthong ba na// g.yon nas lan gsum bskor byas te// spyi bos phyag ni byas nas kyang*// lan gsum bar du gsol ba gdab// bdag ni ma khyod bu yin pas// ji srid byang chub 'byung bar du// byang chub yan lag nu ma las// byung ba'i rang gi 'o mas skyongs// gnyis med ye shes spyod ldan pa'i// bslab pa blangs pa sngon 'gro bas// sgra sogs stong pa sngon 'gro ba'i// tshangs par spyod pa shin tu bsrung*// dam tshig de la rtag gnas te// de sngon 'gro bas sbas pa'i yid// spyod dang grol ba'i 'bras 'dod pa'i// yid la 'dod pa'i dngos grub 'gyur// zhes brjod la/

slob mas/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de ltar bdag gis bgyid par 'tshal// zhes lan gsum brjod la dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung bar khas blang ngo*// spyod pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ gnyis med ye shes sems ldan pa'i// mi bya ba ni ci yang med// tshangs par spyod pa rtag nos la// 'dod pa lnga la spyad par gyis// gnyis med la gnas zas la ni// rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs brdas// gnyis su med dang thogs med dang*// dam tshig spyod pa spyad pa yin// sna tshogs dbang phyug legs spyad de// tshangs spyod de bzhin bsam gtan no// khro ba med pa'i rgyun bcad pa'i// sgrub pa po yis yongs su bsrung*// rtag tu bsgrub la gnas bya zhing*// yul kun la ni rnal 'byor mar// gnyis med grub pa'i rnal 'byor ma'o// mi brtan srog ni ji srid par// bu khyod kyis ni bsgrub par bya// 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la// ci 'dod par ni longs spyod cig /he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor cher// bsams nas thams cad rab tu brtag /bdag nyid dpa' bo thams cad dang*// rnal 'byor ma ni kun gyi dngos// de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis// he ru ka dpal bdag mchod do// 'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi// khams gsum na ni sdig med de// de bas 'dod la chags bral bar// khyod kyis nam yang ma yin no// bsrung ba'i dam tshig go /lung bstan pa dang gzengs bstod pa ni/ g.yon pa yis ni chos gos mtha'// g.yas pas mi 'jigs stsol mdzad pa// 'khor lo thams cad rnam par gnas// he ru ka dpal lung ston bzhin// mgrin gcig tu ni thams cad kyis// 'di ltar nga yis lung bstan te// he ru ka dpal de bzhin gshegs// dpa' bo mchog tu grub pa'i phyir// srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton// oṃ shrī he ru ka badz+ra aṃ gu ri/ na ma s+sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sa ma ya s+t+waṃḥ bhur+bha waḥswa/ zhes lung bstan cing gzengs bstod pa'o// dbugs dbyung ba ni/

khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che// rgyal ba'i bdag pos gnas pa dang*// da ni bdud rnams las rgyal zhing*// grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin// de nas sangs rgyas nyid thob par// khyed rnams the tshom med pa yin// dbang 'di bskur ba tsam gyis ni// slob ma yon tan bdag por 'gyur// slob dpon nyid kyi bde ba yis// brtan g.yo kun gyi dam tshig yin// dbugs dbyung ba'o// de nas drin la lan gyis blan pa'i phyir bla ma la ci 'byor pa'i yon dbul lo// de ltar slob dpon gyi dbang dang 'brel pa bcu gnyis bstan to// de tshos dkyil 'khor gsum las ri mor bris pa'i dkyil 'khor yin/ dam tshig rtsa ltung bcu bzhi yan lag dang bcas pa bsrung dgos/ dri ma gang dag par byed na/ gtso bor lus kyi dri ma dag par byed/ bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgoms pa la dbang ngo*// de nas gsang ba'i dbang ni/ sa phyogs shin tu dben par byas la bla ma yon gyi mnyes par bya tshogs kyi 'khor los mchod/ gsang ba'i yum dbul/ de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye// rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung*// bdag nyid chen po khyed ji bzhin// mnga' bdag de 'drar bdag la'ang mdzod// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// ces lan gsum du brjod do// de nas yol bas bar bcad la/ bla ma dang gsang ba'i yum he ru ka yab yum du bskyed/ yum gyi mkha' stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma 'dab ma gsum par bskyed la bu ga'i nang du dh+yam̐ dgod/ yab kyi gsang ba stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga par bskyed la bu ga'i nang du bh+yam̐ dgod/ yab yum gnyis ka'i dpral ba gnyis su rtsa sngags gnyis po thig le bsnol du dgod/ mgrin par snying po gnyis/ snying gar nye snying gnyis kyang*/ de bzhin du bsnol la dgod/ yang gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dkar dmar nag gsum du dgod/

lte bar swa ser po/ brla gnyis la ha ljang gu bsam/ de nas sgrub pa'i grogs mchog gcig ā li kā li bgrang du gzhug pa'am/ yang na kā li bor la ā li 'ba' zhig bgrang ngo*// yang na slob dpon nyid kyis yid kyis bgrangs la dbang rdzas rnams mngon du gyur pa'i tshe brda bya/ de nas slob ma'i gdong g.yogs la/ yab kyi gsang gnas las/ byang chub kyi sems ster na/ rje btsun yab las thob pa'i gsang ba'i dbang ngo*// yum gyi mkha' las ster na yum las thob pa'i gsang ba'i dbang ngo*// thod pa la sogs par bzhag nas ster ba rang rig pa'i stobs las thob pa'o// shin tu'ang rtog pa che na zho'am chang la sbyar la sbyin no// de'i dus su slob ma 'od dpag med par bsams la/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ba// bdag gi gsang ba'i dbang gis ni// sems kyi rgyun gyis dbang bskur ro// zhes brjod la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas gdong g.yogs bkrol la/ khyod kyis byang chub kyi sems kyi dkyil 'khor mthong ba yin zhes bstan la ming gdags/ dam tshig sha lnga dang sbyor ba dang brten pa la dbang*/ dri ma gtso bor ngag gi dag par byed/ rlung gi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang ngo*// de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni/ bla ma yon gyis mnyes par bya/ de nas lus thams cad phab pa'i phyag 'bul/ gsang ba'i dbang dang mthun pa'i gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ de nas bla mas slob ma'i lag pa g.yas par/ phyag rgya'i lag pa g.yon pa gtad la/ bla ma nyid kyi phyag slob ma'i mgo bor bzhag la/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di brjod do// 'di ni byang chub grub rnal 'byor// khams lnga bcud kyi bdag nyid can// he ru ka dpal bdag sbyor bas// yang dag bde ba myong bar gyis// deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyi// brtul zhugs bzang pos 'gro don gyis// bram ze rgyal rigs rje rigs dang*// dmangs rigs mthar skyes dag spyod cig

/bha ga'i pad+mar tsum+ba dang*// bdud rtsi rnams ni legs grub kyis// zhes gnang ba sbyin/ de nas phyag rgya gos dang bral ba des/ rang gi dri zhim po'i pad+ma kha phye nas/ grogs mchog la bstan te 'di skad ces smra'o// bram ze rgyal rigs rje rigs dag /dmangs rigs mthar skyes bud med kun// gus dang bcas par mchod pa dang*// gnyis med tshul gyis tsum+ba ni// dpa' bo khyod ni spro gyur tam// smros shig dpa' bo bde ba che// bshang gci dag ni za ba dang*// khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te// sha chen bsten par bu spro'am// zhes dri'o// de nas grogs kyis lan bya ba ni/ ci gsungs dam tshig bsten par ni// lha mo bdag gis byed par nus// zhes lan gdab bo// de nas gdong g.yogs so sor bcing*/ de nas gsang dbang gi skabs ltar dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma gnyis kar bskyed de/ gnas lnga dang mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs te snyoms 'jug byed du gzhug skad cig ma dang dga' ba'i bye brag bstan/ thig le 'dzin pa'i 'khrul 'khor bca'/ dpe'i ye shes nyams su myong ba dang*/ gdong g.yogs dbye/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor las bha ga'i dkyil 'khor mthong*/ shes rab ma la brten nas ye shes dga' ba bzhi'i dbang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag dam tshig dngos sam 'od kyi rig ma bsten pa la dbang ngo*// zhes brjod de/ thugs kyi rigs mas gang 'dod kyi ming gdags/ pho nya'i lam bstan to// dbang bzhi pa tshig tsam gyis bskur na/ bla ma la yon dbul/ de nas/ khyod zhabs pad+mo'i bka' drin gyis// gtso bo dbang bskur rnam gsum thob// de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*// bdag la bka' drin bskyab tu gsol// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba gdab/ yang gdong g.yogs bcings la/ de nas/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje snying po mkha' dang mtshungs// rdul bral mthar ster zhi ba nyid// khyod kyi pha yang khyod nyid do// zhes brjod de/

sems nyid gnyug ma dang*/ dbang gsum pa'i nyams su myong ba gnyis/ ro gcig par nyams su long shig ces ngo sprod cing gdams so// de nas gdong g.yogs phye la/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor las don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor mthong*/ dbang las tshig tsam la brten nas bzhi pa mchog dbang rin po che thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag lus ngag yid gsum mi phyed pa rdo rje lta bur byas pa yin no// zhes brjod la/ lam bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rim pa bstan no// dam tshig khyod kyis srog chags gsad par bya// la sogs pa dgongs te gsungs pa mtha' dag bsrung ba la dbang ngo zhes brjod do// sa māp+ta/ slob dpon nag po pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la brten nas dbang bzhi'i cho ga mdor bsdus pa rdzogs so// //de lta bu'i tshul gyis dbang bzhi bskur ba ni/ sgrub pa por 'os pa gang yin yang rung*/ gcig nas nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar du ji tsam yod pa la sbyin te/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ mkhas pas slob ma gcig gam gsum// lnga'am yang na bdun dag gam// nyi shu rtsa ni lnga yi bar// zung du ma gyur slob ma gzung*// de bas lhag pa'i slob ma dag /yongs su gzung bar mi shis so// zhes gsungs so// nyer lnga po'i nang nas slob dpon du 'os pa gcig yin te/ spyi rgyud las/ slob dpon blo gros chen po yis// sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin pa por// slob ma dam pa snying rje can// gcig ni nan tan bskyed de gzung*// zhes gsungs pas so// de lta bu'i slob dpon du 'os pa des/ dpa' bo chen po la sogs pa gsol ba lan gsum du gdab/ dbang gi skabs de nyid dam/ gzhan du yang rung ste/ slob dpon du 'os pa de seng ge'i khri'i steng du bzhag mngon par byang chub pa lnga'am/ cho ga gsum gyis rdo rje 'chang chen por bskyed/ go cha bcing*/ ye shes pa dang ro gcig tu byas te/

spros pa la dga' na chu'i dbang nas brtul zhugs kyi bar du ldabs la bskur gsung*/ phyag len ni/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// he ru ka dpal phyag na bsnams// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// he ru ka dpal brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya/ tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ/ dhā ra ya mi hūm̐ ha ha ha ho/ zhes brjod do// chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gi brjod bya'i rang bzhin can gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje lag pa g.yas par byin la/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /kye bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o// zhes brjod de sems thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlab/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed// oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥ.aḥ zhes brjod de chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gi rjod byed kyi rang bzhin can gyi dril bu/ lag pa g.yon par byin la/ aḥ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa// srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur// zhes brjod de ngag gsung rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlab/ de nas rdo rje dril bu snying gar bsnol du bcug la/ rdo rje rab gnas rdo rje che// che dang dril bu chen po zung*// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis// la sogs pa brjod cing*/ lus rdo rje 'chang yab yum du bsam pa sku rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlab par bya'o// de tsam gyis rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi ngo bo ste/ kye'i rdo rje las/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la// rdo rje dril bus yang dag 'khyud// thabs dang shes rab mnyam sbyor la// slob dpon dbang du brjod pa yin// zhes gsungs so// de nas de la dkyil 'khor dang lha'i de kho na nyid bstan zhing*/

bsnyen pa dkyil 'khor bya ba la sogs pa/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams kyang bslabs la/ rdo rje slob dpon rjes su gnang ba sbyin par bya ste/ sems can mchog de la 'di skad du'o// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin 'gyur bar// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// lha rnams kun gyis bzhed pa yin// sems can rnams ni rjes gzung phyir// dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin du bris// khyod kyis nan tan bskyed nas su// sgrub pa po rnams sngags la sbyor// zhes rjes su gnang ba byin la/ bdag gi don la chags pa tha mal gyi 'du shes dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa la chags pa nyan rang gi 'du shes spangs la/ 'khor bar snang ba 'di rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'i ngang nas sems can gyi don rgya chen po bsgrub par gdams so// de nas dbang gi skabs yin na lha mchod pa la sogs pa'i rjes gnang rnams sgrub pa po dang thun mong du sbyin/ skabs gzhan yin na tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po dang*/ bla ma la/ lus dang longs spyod thams cad sems can gyi don du ltos pa med par phul la/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// la sogs pas bka' bzhin bsgrub par khas blang ngo gsung ngo*// i thi// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
